clauses.text: The education savings account program is repealed effective July 1, 2028. Funds remaining in an account on that date revert to the state school fund.

current_law: A parent of a child eligible to attend public school may open an education savings account funded with 90 percent of state per-pupil funding, usable for private tuition, tutoring, textbooks, and online courses.
